n, kl = map(int, input().split())
fmod = 998244353

if kl >= n:
    print(0)
    exit()

k = kl

fact = [1] * (n + 1)
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % fmod

ifact = [0] * (n + 1)

def fpow(a, b):
    res = 1
    base = a
    exp = b
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % fmod
        base = (base * base) % fmod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def ifact_func(x):
    if ifact[x] > 0:
        return ifact[x]
    else:
        ifact[x] = fpow(fact[x], fmod - 2)
        return ifact[x]

def fmul(a, b):
    return (a * b) % fmod

ans = 0
mult = 1
for i in range(n - k + 1):
    add = mult * fpow(n - k - i, n)
    add = (add * fact[n - k]) % fmod
    add = (add * ifact_func(i)) % fmod
    add = (add * ifact_func(n - k - i)) % fmod
    add = add if mult > 0 else -add
    while add < 0:
        add += fmod
    ans = (ans + add) % fmod
    mult = -mult

res = (fmul(fmul(ans, fact[n]), fmul(ifact_func(k), ifact_func(n - k)))) % fmod

if k == 0:
    print(res)
else:
    print(fmul(res, 2))
